events.description: Step beyond logic and into luminous clarity with Janel’s Divine Insight Sessions—your choice of an Akashic Records Reading or an Angel Card Reading, each designed to unlock profound guidance from higher realms. Customize your session based on what you need most. Through the Akashic Records, Janel helps you access the “Book of Your Soul,” revealing patterns, past-life influences, and future potentials shaping your path today. Prefer a gentler, more symbolic connection? Her Angel Card Readings offer direct, heart-centered messages that bring reassurance, direction, and alignment to your daily life. 30-minute sessions are ideal for focused guidance—perfect for a clear question, immediate insight, or a concise Akashic or Angel Card experience. 60-minute sessions allow for a deeper, more expansive exploration, offering greater depth within the Akashic Records, extended intuitive dialogue, or a more layered and immersive reading experience. Whether you’re seeking clarity, confirmation, or a broader perspective, this is where insight meets the soul—and guidance becomes tangible.

events.title: The Sacred Walk: Cultivating Peace Through the Season With Eve
events.description: The Sacred Walk: Cultivating Peace Through the Season What if this holiday season felt less overwhelming and more meaningful? The holidays can bring joy and celebration, but also stress, exhaustion, and endless expectations. Somewhere in the busyness, we often forget to care for ourselves. Join Eve, Melissa, and Karen for a restorative experience designed to help you slow down, release stress, and rediscover your sense of peace and balance. Through sacred ceremony, sound healing, guided meditation, and grounding practices, you will learn simple ways to navigate seasonal challenges with greater calm, clarity, and intention. You will also create your own personal sacred bundle to take home, a meaningful reminder to stay grounded and connected to yourself throughout the season. **Three practitioners bringing their unique gifts together:** Melissa offers shamanic wisdom and sacred ceremony. Karen brings intuitive guidance and energy healing. Eve blends spiritual education, intention, and energy practices. You cannot always control the chaos around you, but you can change how you move through it. **This season, give yourself permission to slow down, breathe, and find peace in the midst of it all.** Investment: $77 Limited to 25 participants

events.title: Lisa Maria Intuitive Tarot and Somatic Healing
events.description: With Lisa Maria at Sacred Ground, choose the session that meets you where you are: Intuitive Tarot or Somatic Healing. Intuitive Tarot opens a space of reflection and clarity. The cards—rich with symbolic wisdom—offer insight into your present moment and illuminate possibilities ahead. Lisa Maria’s calm, intuitive presence lets the messages unfold naturally, clear and easy to connect with. Thirty-minute sessions are ideal for one or two focused questions; sixty-minute sessions allow a deeper exploration of what is shifting. Lisa Maria gently guides stagnant or overactive energy back toward balance, flow, and coherence. Each session is unique—some leave deeply relaxed, others with emotional release, clarity, or a lighter, more regulated sense of self. Book Tarot or Somatic Healing on her booking page. events.title: Past Life Regression Session With Karen
events.description: Past Life Regression with Karen is a deeply immersive journey into the memories, emotions, and experiences that may exist beyond this lifetime. Through gentle guided relaxation and meditation, Karen helps you enter a calm, expanded state where images, feelings, people, places, and stories can begin to emerge naturally. During the session, you may explore a past life that connects to a current relationship, repeating pattern, fear, gift, challenge, or unexplained feeling in your present life. Often, what comes through offers surprising clarity and a deeper understanding of why certain themes continue to appear, as well as what your soul may be trying to learn or release. Karen guides the experience with compassion and intuition, helping you feel safe, grounded, and supported throughout. You may also receive insight into soul connections, unfinished lessons, or strengths carried from another lifetime into this one. Many people leave with a profound sense of peace, validation, and a new perspective on their life, relationships, and path moving forward.

events.title: Reiki with Rose Using the Energies of the Ankh & Archangels
events.description: Ankh Life Force Alignment Those who know Rose know that the spaces she creates are unlike any other. There is a quiet reverence, a sense of peace, and a palpable sacredness that begins the moment you enter the room. This next evolution of her practice is an invitation to experience the gifts of her journey—and perhaps awaken something that has always been waiting within you. After a profound journey through Egypt, Rose returned home with a deepened connection to her healing work. Immersed in the energy of ancient temples & pyramids, timeless spiritual traditions, and the enduring symbolism of the Ankh—the Key of Life—she came home carrying something that is difficult to put into words. Some experiences are learned. Others are remembered. The wisdom, presence, and sacredness Rose encountered have naturally woven themselves into the healing practice she has lovingly cultivated for years. Through Reiki, crystals, tuning forks, healing sound, sacred oils, and the symbolism of the Ankh, she creates a deeply intentional space where healing is invited, balance is restored, and the spirit is gently supported.

Surrounded by the healing vibrations of sound and the gentle, nurturing energy of Reiki, you’ll be invited to release the need to accomplish, fix, or figure anything out. Simply arrive, get comfortable, and allow yourself to receive. This experience embraces the quiet, receptive energy of the season: restful, intuitive, grounding, and deeply nourishing. For one evening, instead of asking, “What do I need to accomplish?” ask yourself: “What do I need to receive?” Come rest. Come receive. Come home to yourself. Space is intentionally limited to just 12 participants for a deeply personal and restorative experience.

events.title: Beyond the Physical: Intuitive Mediumship With Lori
events.description: Mediumship is a practice centered around connection, remembrance, and the belief that the bonds of love continue even after someone has passed. These private mediumship sessions are designed for individuals who would like the opportunity to connect with loved ones who have passed away in a peaceful, supportive, and grounded environment. Each 60-minute session begins with a few moments of grounding and energetic clearing, allowing you to settle into the space, quiet the outside world, and become present for the experience. From there, the medium will open to positive, loving spiritual energy and allow the connection to unfold naturally. Mediumship is not about forcing a particular person to appear or controlling exactly what comes through. Instead, the medium serves as a bridge, remaining receptive to impressions, feelings, images, memories, personalities, symbols, or messages that may arise during the session. When a connection is made, the intention is to provide meaningful information that helps you recognize and understand the loved one who may be coming forward. For many people, a mediumship session can be an opportunity for remembrance, reassurance, reflection, and even healing. Sometimes the most meaningful moments are found in small details—a familiar personality trait, a shared memory, a phrase, or a feeling that brings someone you love close to your heart again. The final 5–10 minutes of the session are reserved for debriefing, reflection, and questions. This gives you time to process what came through, talk about the experience, and leave feeling grounded and supported. Every session is unique, just as every relationship is unique. While a specific connection or message can never be guaranteed, each session is approached with respect, compassion, positive intention, and an open heart.

events.title: Keeper of the Cards: Robert
events.description: Robert – Intuitive Card Reader (Playing Card Readings) There is nothing complicated about the tools Robert uses—and that’s exactly what makes his work so extraordinary. With nothing more than a traditional deck of playing cards, Robert delivers readings that are clear, direct, and often astonishingly accurate. No elaborate spreads. No mystical theatrics. Just a method passed down through three generations, refined over time into something both simple and profoundly effective. What sets Robert apart is not just what he sees—it’s how he works. He asks no questions. You shuffle the cards. He begins to speak. From the moment the reading starts, information comes through with a natural flow—insight into what’s currently unfolding in your life, what’s shifting beneath the surface, and what is already set into motion. There’s no need to explain your situation or give background. In many ways, that’s part of the experience—watching as he describes details, dynamics, and possibilities with striking clarity, often before you’ve said a single word. Robert’s readings are known for their timing. Again and again, clients find that what he shares aligns with real-life events that unfold over the next 3 days, 3 weeks, and 3 months. It’s not about vague impressions or general advice—it’s about tangible, grounded insight that you can actually recognize as it begins to happen. Some people come in curious. Some come in skeptical. Almost all leave surprised. There’s something deeply compelling about hearing your path reflected back to you in a way that feels both immediate and predictive—where patterns become clear, decisions feel more grounded, and the unknown becomes just a little more understandable. His sessions are focused, efficient, and deeply personal. Whether you’re navigating change, seeking direction, or simply wanting to understand what’s ahead, Robert offers a perspective that is both practical and intuitive—rooted in real-time insight rather than guesswork. Many who sit with him return—not out of habit, but because they’ve seen the accuracy for themselves. This is a reading where you shuffle… and he talks. And what unfolds from there is something you’ll likely be thinking about long after you leave.
